headword: {必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}

definitions.explanation: An academic course that students must take to fulfill graduation requirements.

examples.japanese: {英語|えいご}は{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}だ。
{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}を{落|お}とすと{卒業|そつぎょう}できない。
examples.english: If you fail a required course, you can't graduate.

examples.japanese: {一年生|いちねんせい}の{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}は{全部|ぜんぶ}で{十|じゅう}{科目|かもく}ある。
examples.english: There are ten required courses in the first year.

notes:
{必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく} refers to courses that are mandatory for all students in a program. Failing to complete required courses prevents graduation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}を{取|と}る (to take a required course)
- {必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}を{履修|りしゅう}する (to enroll in a required course)
- {必修科目|ひっしゅうかもく}の{単位|たんい} (credits for required courses)

RELATED TERMS:
- {選択科目|せんたくかもく} (elective course)
- {必修|ひっしゅう} (compulsory, required)
- {履修|りしゅう} (course enrollment)
